_meta.description: Public companies with meaningful AI exposure, grouped by where they sit in the stack. Built from ETF holdings (BOTZ, ROBO, IRBO, AIQ, CHAT, SMH, SOXX) and known public AI-adjacent names. Not investment advice; 'AI exposure' ranges from pure-play to a small % of a diversified business.

fields.primary: stack layer -> weight (0-1, sums to 1). Derived: sum of sub weights per layer via taxonomy
fields.subs: niche -> weight (0-1, sums to 1). First key = dominant exposure
fields.region: listing / HQ region (US, CN, JP, KR, TW, EU, IL, IN, CA, SEA)
